newsitem.title: USA: Allegiance buys respiratory product line.
newsitem.headline: Allegiance buys respiratory product line.

text.p: Allegiance Healthcare Corp, a unit of Allegiance Corp, said Thursday it acquired a line of respiratory care devices and supplies from Kendall Healthcare Products Co.

Allegiance bought Kendall's line of nebulizers, humidifiers, unit-dose vials and ventilator circuits, as well as related assets. The products generate annual sales of about $10 million, the company said.
The items are used in hospitals, nursing homes and patients' homes. Allegiance said it will integrate the products into its Airlife Respiratory Care business.

"In addition to broadening our product portfolio, this acquistion will strengthen our position in alternate-site delivery settings, which we have identified as a growth opportunity for Allegiance," Lester Knight, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
Nearly half of Kendall's sales were from outside hospitals.
Allegiance, through its subsidiaries, provides healthcare products and cost-management services needed by hospitals, laboratories and others.
